sloka: दिष्ट्या विजयिनं त्वाद्य पश्यामः सह सीतया ।लक्ष्मणेन च धर्मात्मन्भ्रात्रा त्वद्धितकारिणा ।। ७.१.२० ॥
transliteration: diṣṭyā vijayinaṁ tvādya paśyāmaḥ saha sītayā ।lakṣmaṇena ca dharmātmanbhrātrā tvaddhitakāriṇā ।। 7.1.20 ॥

translations.english: O righteous one, it is fortunate that today we see you victorious, accompanied by Sita and by Lakshmana, your brother who always acts for your welfare.
